ebc6b0d7ac:
Only one with the aptitude of a Newtype, the evolution
of mankind, is fit to succeed the Vist Foundation.
Don't you think so, Alberto?
122b8445db:
...But how
do you judge that aptitude?
09ba6a8c44:
One who can protect what must be protected,
however desperate the situation.
That is the kind of power I seek.
ca05a09e96:
(He's looking for another successor, when I'm here...?
 I will never accept such a thing.
 I'll get in the way.)
667a7bb945:
I've heard the rumors, Tiffa Adill.
They say you can talk with Musha Gundam
and Knight Gundam.
b041f7cf15:
That's not quite right.
They speak one-sidedly through my body.
I can't actually talk with them.
03f2552dc5:
I-is that so...? No, that's good enough.
I want to speak with them.
Could you call them here?
37d0bf15ef: Even if you tell me to call them, it's not so easy...
aaba8ffde8:
Wh-what!?
So this is Knight Gundam!
f131979db5:
I am Knight Gundam. I owe Tiffa Adill
for her help in the past.
Of course I come when she is in trouble.
35521871bf:
You're surprisingly loyal.
I'm sorry to rush, but I have a favor to ask.
322eb6fd26:
There is a candidate for "True Gundam Warrior" here,
but we cannot tell whether their skill is genuine.
So we would like you to judge for us.
c96bdd567c:
So there is a "True Gundam Warrior" here as well.
Very well, I shall lend a hand.
I will have Musha Gundam and the others help too.
d41da11569:
Thank you very much.
Everything is prepared. This way, please.
c62f5b759e:
Ugh... Knight Gundam...
You mean you're going to fight again?
e345cf8edb:
Alberto Vist had Tiffa Adill found and summoned:
the girl rumored to be able to talk with a mysterious
mobile suit called Knight Gundam.
26202ad01d:
Knight Gundam is searching for the "True Gundam
Warrior." By passing off a Vist heir candidate as one,
Alberto meant to make them fight Knight Gundam.
0c0e38c135:
I heard it from her, Alberto.
You tricked Knight Gundam and the others
by claiming a "True Gundam Warrior" was here.
e6514b02fb:
Th-that wasn't a trick.
Besides, you can't choose the Vist heir
by something as vague as Newtype aptitude.
b43c05ac69:
So I thought the one worthy of being called the
"True Gundam Warrior" is the one who qualifies. And to
judge that, we should rely on Knight Gundam...
770450ca9d:
You never said a single word
about any of that.
68f38d6aa9:
I-it's not that I didn't explain...
You just didn't ask...
c29c7709fc:
Enough.
Thanks to this, we found a fine candidate.
Though we did Knight Gundam a disservice.
a28b2e5248:
They aren't angry.
If anything, they're happy to have found
the "True Gundam Warrior."
58e47e8f4e:
I am Knight Gundam...
It is as she says. We are happy
to have met the "True Gundam Warrior" once again.
441acb6b5b:
Yes, that one is the "True Gundam Warrior."
Not someone to be confined as heir
to your petty foundation.
013b42683d:
A broad view, keen insight, a righteous heart...
And above all, the power to protect what must be
protected. That one possesses it all.
b55c1856c7:
We will take that one with us.
Not someone to be used for your selfish desires!
85d5345d14:
M-Musha Gundam!?
...Wait, take them with you?
9b8c1597c7:
Alberto, you will answer for this blunder.
You'll pay for it!
